_note: Publisher-level policy pages, each verified by visiting during research on 2026-07-15. Keys match the Publisher column exactly. Fields: oa_options (gold/hybrid/green routes), embargo_sharing (self-archiving / green OA / repository deposit + embargo), apc (article processing charge info / price lists). 'note' carries a caveat shown to users. Small publishers additionally get journal-level pages built by build_final.py.

Wiley.note: Publisher-level pages. Green OA embargo is 12-24 months depending on the journal; society-owned titles may set their own terms - confirm on the journal's own page.

Springer Nature.note: Publisher-level pages; APC varies by journal (see the journal website's Open Access Fees and Funding section). Self-archiving embargo is typically up to 12 months.

Association of Computing Machinery (ACM).note: ACM moved to fully open access on 2026-01-01 under the ACM Open model; APCs apply to authors at non-participating institutions. There is effectively no green-OA embargo (immediate OA). Policies are publisher-level (ACM does not publish per-journal policy pages); journal home pages are on the ACM Digital Library (dl.acm.org).

Cambridge University Press.note: Green OA embargo is typically 6 months (science/medical) to 12 months (humanities/social science) - confirm on the journal's own page.

American Chemical Society (ACS).note: Standard green OA embargo is 12 months for hybrid journals; a zero-embargo green OA option exists (see the sharing/public-access page). APC/pricing is via the ACS pricing estimator, not a flat per-journal list.

Institute of Physics (IOP).note: Green OA embargo is 12 months (subscription articles). Full APC price list is downloadable from the APC page; preprints may be shared any time.

Royal Society of Chemistry.note: Green OA embargo is 12 months. Gold OA APCs listed on the payments page; RSC members get a 15% discount.

Microbiology Society.note: Green OA (self-archiving) and APC terms are on the linked publisher pages; the accepted manuscript may be deposited, and NIH-mandated deposits are allowed with zero embargo.

The Company of Biologists.note: Journal-level pages. Self-archiving of the accepted manuscript is allowed (including zero-embargo PMC deposit for NIH compliance) where standard routes do not meet a mandate.

Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory Press.note: Journal-level pages. Articles become free 6 months after publication; immediate OA available for an APC. Pre/post-prints may be self-archived; complies with NIH Public Access (6-month).

Cogitatio Press.note: Fully open access (all journals) under CC BY with no embargo; authors retain copyright. Links go to the journal's own Editorial Policies page (Open Access / Archiving / Publication Fees sections).
